text:
sophia: heads-up — p99 latency for llm/llama3-13b-chat on dedicated pool jumped ~35% after yesterday's config sweep. Anyone seen this?
munir: saw it in dashboards, p95->p99 widening. suspect kernel selector flip to fallback path.
ava: can you paste the run id / sample trace?
sophia: run 2026-03-17_23:24, trace id tx-9f3. Quick perf summary:
```
p50 12ms p95 78ms p99 254ms 99.9 512ms
payload: avg seq 512, prefix 320
```
munir: that sequence distribution is long; default rope_theta=1000 may be misaligned with model config (hidden dim 4096, heads 32). Kernel switch logs?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: selector switched kernel from fused-atten->fallback-matmul at 23:24:11 for model=llama3-13b variant=chattemplate
liam: fallback-matmul is much slower with large kv because we lose prefetch / blocked kernels.
sophia: profiling flame: top spin is `kv_copy` + `matmul_eager` in loop. snippet:
```
# perf log
kv_copy 42% matmul_eager 29% host-sync 12% other 17%
```
ava: are we evicting KV too often? cache hit rates?
munir: cache hit rate dropped to 63% for that workload (expected ~92%). We saw frequent cache invalidations when headkv layout differs across variants.
sophia: config sweep changed `head_dim_remap=true` for mix models; that may have forced dequantization path.
liam: also saw `rmsnorm` operator fallback to reference SiLU path in logs — that adds overhead.
munir: hypothesis: rope_theta default changed in sweep to 10k for stability; with large theta fastpath kernel didn't match and we fell to generic kernel.
ava: can we repro locally with seq=512 and forced kernel selection?
sophia: yes. repro run attached: `./runner --model llama3-13b --seq 512 --chat-template --force-fastpath=false`
liam: try toggling head_dim_remap off and forcing fused-atten.
munir: quick experiment results:
```
experiment A: fused-atten forced -> p99 180ms
experiment B: fallback-matmul -> p99 260ms
```
sophia: so kernel choice explains ~30% of delta. Remaining diff maybe kv copy overhead due to stride mismatch in headkv layout.
ava: patch idea: align head_kv layout logic to prefer contiguous KV when chat template is used (prefix-heavy). Also add metric to track `cache_evicts_per_session`.
liam: agree. Also we should whitelist rope_theta range per model to ensure kernel selector doesn't pick extremes.
munir: created draft PR #4123 with change to selector heuristics + telemetry. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4123
sophia: can we also add an automated perf smoke after config sweeps that runs 3 canonical templates (short, medium, prefix-heavy) and verifies p99 not increased >5%?
ops-bot: perf-bot scheduled smoke job in CI: perf/smoke/config-sweep at 03:00 UTC
ava: I'll run extended repro on dedicated pool tomorrow morning and post flame graphs.
liam: add test to pin head_dim_remap=false for chattemplate until we validate.
sophia: thanks — let's merge selector fix behind feature flag and monitor. :thumbsup: 
munir: noted, will roll out canary to 10% and watch cache hits/lats.
